label: Form 8 correction window closes
description: Last date to submit corrections to name, address, or photo on the electoral roll.

label: Draft electoral roll publication
description: Draft rolls published for public review. Check your name and details.

label: New voter registration deadline
description: Last date for new voter registration for upcoming bye-elections.

label: Tamil Nadu Bye-Election — Hosur AC
description: Bye-election for Hosur Assembly Constituency. Ensure your voter details are up to date.

label: Model Code of Conduct begins — Karnataka
description: MCC enforcement begins. No new registrations or changes allowed after this date.

label: Voter photo upload window closes
description: Last date to upload or update your photograph on the electoral roll.

label: Form 8A transposition deadline
description: Last date to apply for transposition of entry within the same constituency.
